lights.name: PointLight_35
lights.note: Room with the stove (x 24.5-36.5, z 11-27): fill light 2 m above the middle of the floor, no source. With shadows it threw the crates' shadows outwards from the middle. With RTGI the bounce of the window light, the stove and the candle (physical lamps) light the room, the frame is 0.8 of 255 darker without it.

lights.note: Torch hall (x -10..0, z 7-26): warm fill 'light of the torch over the whole hall' next to each torch, the script fades it with the torches (TimerOpenDoor01 lightsout). The physical torches (10 candles, 24 m) and RTGI light the hall themselves, without it the pillars cast their shadows on the walls.
